title.narrative: Expanded and reinforced Social Protection Floors at the policy and programmatic level as per the commitment of AU Member States

description.narrative:
Africa has the lowest social protection coverage globally (19.1 per cent vs. 52.4 per cent). Gaps in financing, governance, coordination and technical capacity limit the effectiveness and inclusiveness of systems, particularly in reaching workers in the informal and rural economy, migrant workers and other vulnerable populations.
This CPO supports a more coordinated and evidence-based approach to social protection by strengthening regional alignment, stakeholder collaboration and national policy design. It contributes to the adoption of a regional strategy aligned with international labour standards to enhance coherence, governance and inclusive, resilient systems.
Expected results include: Africa Regional Social Protection Strategy 2021–2025 reviewed and the strategy for 2026–2030 adopted; research, data and knowledge products produced and disseminated; and capacity-building services delivered to relevant stakeholders to strengthen their ability to design and implement evidence-based social protection policies at the regional and national levels. The programme also supports regional coordination to extend social protection coverage to underserved populations.
The primary beneficiaries include vulnerable populations and national institutions responsible for social protection. Implementation is carried out in partnership with regional organizations, national governments, and key stakeholders to promote policy coherence, knowledge sharing, and sustainable system strengthening across Africa.
